integration.scope: Declared destination and selected member-contract choices with exact supporting source locators. Choice values may name consumer modules; the index does not infer a universal layout or execute those modules.

scope.paths: All paths are project-relative except package_path, which is relative to the immutable package directory. source_path is the recorded source, not a verified destination import.
scope.metadata: Contract values and X.mt are declared data. Opaque metadata has no universal frame/layout schema; missing or uninterpreted layout is not inferred from filenames, kind, dimensions or lineage.
scope.review: Current criteria apply to the selected exact candidates. Package creation accepted=false remains historical; current_eligible requires current nomination, completed tasks, passing declared criteria, current bindings and no pending work or drift.
scope.acceptance: This read creates no acceptance and does not observe destination bytes, authenticate remote execution, or establish undeclared engine or human acceptance. Refresh after changes; full history remains in the existing state and manifest.
